<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="court" name="Court" processRef="court-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="court-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="court-office" name="Court office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check_files</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>files_missing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>search_files</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge_files</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>track_files</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>split_parallel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>handover_files</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>distribute_lawlist</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>join_parallel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>conduct_hearings</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Each morning" />
    <bpmn:task id="check_files" name="Check the files yet to be processed are in order for the day's court hearing" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="files_missing" name="Files missing?" />
    <bpmn:task id="search_files" name="Initiate a search for the missing files" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge_files" />
    <bpmn:task id="track_files" name="Track the files physically to the intended location" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="split_parallel" />
    <bpmn:task id="handover_files" name="Hand the files over to the Associate" />
    <bpmn:task id="distribute_lawlist" name="Distribute the Judge's Lawlist to the relevant people" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join_parallel" />
    <bpmn:task id="conduct_hearings" name="Conduct the directions hearings" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Directions hearings conducted" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="check_files" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="check_files" targetRef="files_missing" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" name="yes" sourceRef="files_missing" targetRef="search_files" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="no" sourceRef="files_missing" targetRef="merge_files" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="search_files" targetRef="merge_files" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="merge_files" targetRef="track_files" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="track_files" targetRef="split_parallel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="split_parallel" targetRef="handover_files" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="split_parallel" targetRef="distribute_lawlist" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="handover_files" targetRef="join_parallel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="distribute_lawlist" targetRef="join_parallel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="join_parallel" targetRef="conduct_hearings" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="conduct_hearings" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
